M_SWB.evidence_source: [/page/12/Text/2] Players who were cut/dropped-out had lower self-esteem and positive affect as season one progressed (M_{\text{wavel}} = 5.68, 5.76; M_{\text{wave2}} = 5.14, 5.11), compared with the stable level of self-esteem and positive affectivity experienced by participants who remained in the program (M_{\text{wavel}} = 5.94, 6.01; M_{\text{wave2}} = 5.93, 5.98). The interaction for negative affect indicated that the attrition group showed increased emotional ill-being over the course of season one (M_{\text{wave1}} = 2.33; M_{\text{wave2}} = 3.22), compared with the marginal increases exhibited by the participants who stayed in the program (M_{\text{wavel}} = 2.11; M_{\text{wave2}} = 2.31).
